items.exampleEn: I practice my pronunciation with songs.
Punctuation helps people read your writing.
items.exampleZh: 標點符號能幫助別人讀懂你寫的東西。

items.exampleEn: She always finishes her schoolwork before dinner.
items.exampleZh: 她總是在晚餐前做完學校功課。

items.exampleEn: Use the superlative to talk about the best one.
items.exampleZh: 要說「最好的那一個」時就用最高級。

items.exampleEn: Please write your name in capital letters.
items.exampleZh: 請用大寫字母寫你的名字。

items.exampleEn: The headteacher gave a speech on the first day.
items.exampleZh: 校長在開學第一天致詞。

items.exampleEn: Our high school has a big swimming pool.
items.exampleZh: 我們高中有一座大游泳池。

items.sentenceEn: Names always begin with a capital letter.
items.sentenceZh: 名字一定要用大寫字母開頭。

items.audioEn: The headteacher says students must finish their schoolwork at home.
items.audioZh: 校長說學生必須在家完成學校功課。

items.sentenceEn: My pronunciation got better after the trip.
items.sentenceZh: 那趟旅行之後，我的發音進步了。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher marked every punctuation error in red.
items.sentenceZh: 老師用紅筆標出每一個標點錯誤。

items.stemEn: Check the question marks in your essay. Your ____ needs work.
items.stemZh: 檢查一下文章裡的問號，你的標點符號還要加強。

items.stemEn: My sister is fifteen. She goes to ____.
items.stemZh: 我的姊妹十五歲，她在讀高中。

items.passageEn: Leo is in his first year of high school. His English is good, but his pronunciation is not clear. He also forgets capital letters and punctuation in his writing. His teacher gave him extra schoolwork, and he worked hard. Last week, the headteacher said his essay was the best in his class.
items.passageZh: Leo 現在高中一年級。他的英文不錯，但發音不太清楚。他寫作時也常忘了大寫字母和標點符號。老師給了他額外的功課，他很努力地寫。上週，校長說他的文章是全班最好的。

questions.questionZh: Leo 寫作時常忘記什麼？
options: 在每頁寫上日期和名字
英文單字的正確拼寫方式
他的文章是全班最好的
他的英文發音是全班最好的

items.promptZh: best 是 good 的最高級。
referenceEn: Best is the superlative of good.
The superlative of good is best.
rubricZh: 「⋯的最高級」可寫例如 the superlative of good

items.promptZh: 老師說我寫的複數錯了。
referenceEn: My teacher said the plural I wrote was wrong.
The teacher said that I got the plural wrong.
rubricZh: 用 plural 表示「複數」（例如 the plural I wrote、got the plural wrong 等）
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 said…was、says…is 等）；said 後面的 that 可加可省略
